BiblicalUsage: Chalat means to snatch at, to catch hastily — and it appears once, when Ben-Hadad's men caught at Ahab's word of mercy and seized on it as a promise.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe desperate men catch at any word of life, and Ahab's careless word was caught before he could take it back.
